# pgauthz

> A PostgreSQL-native authorization engine (Google Zanzibar / OpenFGA relationship model as SQL functions: tuples, models, conditions, temporal gates, audit and time travel) plus pgauthzd, a stateless Go daemon that serves it over HTTP (AuthZEN 1.0, native API, JWT). Data and decisions stay in PostgreSQL.

One owner per topic. Read the file that owns the topic, not the README.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): pitch, features, setup, a complete example, the documentation map
- [Example models](examples/models/README.md): helloworld, demo, gdrive, github, todo, aia-acme, agents, fourquestions (the four-questions pitch example)

## Reference

- [SQL API](docs/API.md): every public function with signature, return shape and a worked call; recipes
- [Model design](docs/MODEL_DESIGN.md): types, relations, rules, wildcards, conditions (SQL/CEL), temporal gates, model registry, OpenFGA import
- [Audit, time travel, changefeed](docs/AUDIT.md): what changed, what was true at time T, what changed since
- [pgauthzd](pgauthzd/README.md): the HTTP daemon — profiles, environment, AuthZEN, native API, JWT, decision log
- [pgauthzctl](pgauthzctl/README.md): model-as-code CLI — import, test, publish, roll out
- [OPA overlay](opa/README.md): optional policy-as-code sidecar and policy hooks
